fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let error = std::env::var("CONTEXT_ERROR")?;
    let output = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var_os("OUT_DIR").ok_or("missing OUT_DIR")?);
    std::fs::write(output.join("generated.rs"), format!("type GeneratedError = {error};"))?;
    println!("cargo::rustc-cfg=build_ready");
    println!("cargo::rustc-check-cfg=cfg(build_ready)");
    println!("cargo::rustc-env=BUILD_CONTEXT=ready");
    println!("cargo::rerun-if-env-changed=CONTEXT_ERROR");
    Ok(())
}
